items.title: Apple (AAPL) Cuts 200 Jobs In Siri And Vision Pro To Refocus On AI
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is cutting over 200 jobs in its Siri and Vision Pro units as it redirects resources toward artificial intelligence and smart glasses development. The restructuring shifts focus away from immersive video and gaming features in Vision Pro toward AI driven capabilities and new hardware. Apple is concentrating affected roles within its core AI efforts, signalling a reallocation of talent and spending across key product teams. The move is expected to influence Apple's future...
